svg.title: FORJA — Personal gym training PWA
svg.desc: Local-first training app: plans come from a deterministic, unit-tested rule engine built on evidence-backed training principles — no AI decides your plan. Works offline and keeps health data on the device. Architecture: INTERFACE React 19 UI (Tailwind · shadcn/ui, Motion · i18n) → ENGINE Rule engine (pure TypeScript, deterministic · tested) → LOCAL DATA IndexedDB (Dexie · Zustand, Zod schemas); optional modules: Supabase sync (EU · RLS · no health data), 3D anatomy (three.js · React Three Fiber), AI Q&A (WebLLM · Gemini · glossary). KEY SYSTEMS: Full offline PWA (Workbox), installable from the browser; Interactive 3D anatomy model, loaded on demand; Passwordless optional cloud sync between devices; CI + CD to Cloudflare Pages, smoke-tested in production. DESIGN PRINCIPLES: RULES no AI picks the plan, LOCAL health data on device, OFFLINE installable PWA, SMOKE prod checks per deploy. Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, Three.js, Dexie, Supabase, Vitest, PWA. Live at forja-13u.pages.dev.
